panels.shot: Wide. The glass palm house glows gold in a snowy park. Limousines arrive. Guests in furs climb red-carpet steps. Police at the portico.

lines.text: First snow. The owners of the city, in their glass house, warm as summer.

panels.shot: Medium. The hero in his black suit, snow on his shoulders, among the guests. A waiter offers champagne. Nero is with him, off the leash, head high.

lines.text: Nobody stops a man in black tie. Nobody stops a dog with his eyes.
